# Muhammad Saud

> Muhammad Saud (Muhammad Saud Maqsood) is a product designer at Avialdo Solutions in
> Karachi, Pakistan, creating intuitive, visually compelling digital products across UX
> research, design systems, and end-to-end product design.

Contact: saudmaqsood@icloud.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammadsaudmaqsood/

## Positioning

- Operating principle: "Craft + Judgement = Shipped."
- On AI: "Pixels, purpose, a decade of practice and AI didn't replace the craft. It sharpened it."
- Based in Karachi, Pakistan

## Focus areas

AI-Driven UX Strategy, Human-AI Interaction Design, UX UI Design, Vibe-Coding,
Data-Driven Design, Prompt Engineering, Cross-Functional Collaboration,
Innovation Strategy, User Research & Insights, End-to-End Product Design,
Information Architecture, Design Systems & Scalable UI, AI-Assisted Prototyping,
Conversion Optimization, Accessibility & Inclusive Design.
